EFFICIENCY
fields.description: Calculates efficiency based on delays and production, returning 1, a ratio, or 0 as appropriate.

fields.name: Grit in Kg
fields.description: Calculates the slab's grit weight based on the sum of all mixer cycle weights as a proportion of the total cycle weight.

fields.name: Filler in Kg
fields.description: Calculates the slab's filler weight by distributing total mixer cycle filler proportionally to the slab's weight.

fields.name: Total Resin Weight
fields.description: Calculates the slab's resin weight by proportionally distributing total mixer cycle resin based on slab or distributor weight.

fields.name: Sq.ft.
fields.description: Calculates square feet based on Notify Party and Number of Slabs.

fields.name: Total amount
fields.description: Calculates the total amount and appends Rate Unit and Rate per to the result.

fields.name: Total amount in USD
fields.description: Calculates the total amount in USD or INR based on rate, unit, and design type.

fields.name: Total amount in INR
fields.description: Calculates the total amount in USD or INR based on rate, unit, and design type.

fields.name: USD per sqft
fields.description: Calculates the total amount in USD or INR based on rate, unit, and design type.

fields.name: INR per sqft
fields.description: Calculates the total amount in USD or INR based on rate, unit, and design type.

fields.name: Dimention
